title: Unique Umami Chinese Pepper Chow Fun
description: A spicy and comforting Chinese dish featuring pepper and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, suitable for diabetics, in a chow fun form.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Chinese peppercorns, soy sauce, and oyster sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the pork and sauce.
Add the chopped scallions and red pepper flakes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
